title: Wall Coat Rack with Shelf
subtitle: A 30-inch wall-mounted coat rack: a hook board below, a shelf on top, held by two shaped end brackets.

steps.title: Shape the end brackets
steps.text: Mark the angled cut on both end brackets using the points on the parts drawing and cut off the lower front corner. Sand all cut edges.

steps.title: First bracket
steps.text: Stand the hook board on its long edge. Glue the bracket to its end, back edges flush. Pre-drill 1/8″ pilot holes before driving screws.

steps.title: Second bracket
steps.text: Attach the second bracket the same way. Check with a square that both brackets sit at 90°.

steps.title: Shelf
steps.text: Lay the shelf on top, flush at the back and at both ends. The front overhangs the brackets. Screw down into the brackets and the hook board.

extra_materials: 2–3 wood screws #10 × 3″ (or wall anchors rated for the load) for mounting through the hook board
Finish: paint, stain or clear polyurethane
tips: Mount through the hook board into at least two wall studs (16″ apart). If you must use drywall, use anchors rated well above the load.
Space the hooks evenly about 6″ apart, roughly 2″ below the shelf.
Finish all parts before attaching the hooks.
